issues.title: Ingest the Loving County tax levy
issues.detail: The property tax the county levies across its funds.
issues.learned: Total rate $0.46071/$100 on an $18.2B taxable value — a levy of about $84,002,309 for 64 residents. Roughly $284,894,202 of taxable property per person, ~82% of it oil-and-gas minerals. No county debt.

issues.title: Extract line-item appropriations
issues.detail: The county’s adopted budget lists ~28 funds (General, Volunteer Fire, Public Water, Road & Bridge, arena, courthouse), but the county-hosted PDF is a scanned image. Pull the text-extractable state-hosted copy and ingest the appropriations by fund.
